description: Turns a name into an address: “email Priya” → `search: "priya"`. Matches part of a name or an address (`@acme.com` for everyone there), most recent first. Each contact belongs to one of your addresses — `inbox` is the one they correspond with, and the one to write from — so the same person can appear once per address; pass `identity_id` for one. Only people your addresses have exchanged mail with, or that somebody added, are here: no match means you do not know them yet, not that they do not exist. `notes` is what was written about them; `blocked` and `snoozed_until` say whether their mail is reaching the inbox. With `has_more`, pass `next_cursor` as `cursor`.
name: find_contact
title: Find someone to write to
